title: Turning tracking off in Edit Inventory Part hides Min and Max and keeps the bins with their quantities
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T1 (tracked, with stock). Before the run note its Total Qty, Min, Max and each bin with its quantity from the Inventory list.
custom_steps:
1. Go to /parts/inventory (Active tab), search QAPL-T1 and click its row.
  2. In the "Inventory Tracking" section switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" (toggle_track_quantities) off.
  3. Without saving, switch it back on.
  4. Switch it off again and click Save (button_save_inventory_part).
  5. Click the QAPL-T1 row again to reopen Edit Inventory Part.
  6. Cleanup: switch tracking on and click Save.
custom_expected:
1. Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on, Min and Max (input_min / input_max) showing the saved values, and the "Inventory" bin rows showing each bin with its quantity.
  2. Min and Max hide; every bin row stays visible with its quantity unchanged (shelf reference); no confirmation or prompt appears.
  3. Min and Max show again with the same values as before.
  4. The dialog closes with no prompt; without a page reload Total Qty reads "Not Tracked" (text_not_tracked_{id}), the bin chip still shows "{bin} | {qty}" with the noted quantity, and the Min and Max columns still show the saved values (kept but not used, intended).
  5. The switch is off, Min and Max are hidden, and every bin row shows the same bin and quantity as noted before the run.
  6. Total Qty shows "{n} available" again with the noted quantity, and Min/Max show the noted values.
